title: Private Philadelphia Sports Driving Tour
blurb:
Discover the rich sports culture of Philadelphia on this private driving tour that takes you to the city’s most important sports landmarks. With a knowledgeable local guide, visit historic sites like Franklin Field and the Palestra (from the outside), learn about legendary athletes like “Smokin” Joe Frazier, climb the famous Rocky Steps, and gaze upon our magnificent modern sports arenas (from the outside). This immersive experience delves into the impact of sports on Philadelphia’s identity. Perfect for sports enthusiasts and casual fans alike, this tour offers a unique look at the passion that drives Philly sports culture.

- Private, guided tour with a maximum of 6 guests for a personalized experience
- Visit historic sites including Franklin Field and the Palestra
- Climb the Rocky Steps and see the statue of boxing legend “Smokin” Joe Frazier
- Explore the stadium complex housing the Eagles, Flyers, Phillies, and 76ers (from the outside)
- Visit picturesque Boathouse Row
